start: App opened; the MettleUp team has replied to an earlier question; red dot with 1 on the round button

steps.action: Look at the round chat button
user_sees: A red dot with '1' on the half of the button that shows
must_not: The dot on the half hidden behind the edge
A dot when no reply is unread

steps.action: Tap the round button
user_sees: Sheet titled 'The MettleUp team answered you'
The question with its day, the 'Quick answer' (automatic) if there was one, then 'Reply from the MettleUp team' with a 'New' tag and the time
must_not: The empty message box instead of the reply
Replies out of time order

steps.action: Close the sheet
user_sees: The red dot gone
must_not: The dot coming back for the same reply
The reply lost from 'Your questions'

steps.action: Scroll to 'Your questions'
user_sees: Every question sent from this phone, newest first, each with its answers
must_not: Questions from another phone
'Questions you send from this phone show here, with their answers.' when there are some

steps.action: Keep the page open while the team replies in HQ
user_sees: Within about a minute the reply appears with 'New'
must_not: The reply only after leaving and coming back

start: Phone shows the pop-up 'The MettleUp team answered your question'

steps.action: Tap the pop-up 'Tap to read the answer.'
user_sees: The app opens on 'Your questions' with the reply marked 'New'
must_not: The app opens on the home tab with no reply
Two pop-ups for the same reply

start: A new phone, no question ever sent

steps.action: Open Profile → Settings → Help and feedback
user_sees: 'Your questions'
'Questions you send from this phone show here, with their answers.'
must_not: A spinner that never ends
Someone else's questions

steps.action: Tap the round button
user_sees: The message box, no 'See your questions and answers' button
must_not: An empty conversations sheet
A red dot

start: A question sent seconds ago, answer on its way

steps.action: Open 'Your questions'
user_sees: 'Waiting for the answer. It usually takes a few seconds.'
must_not: 'Waiting' for ever after the answer came

steps.action: Wait a few seconds on the page
user_sees: The waiting line turns into the Quick answer, or 'The MettleUp team will reply here.'
must_not: The page needing to be left to update

steps.action: Later the team replies; open the round button, then 'Ask something new'
user_sees: The reply 'New' once, then the message box
must_not: The reply still 'New' on the next open
The red dot still on after reading

start: Two members share a phone, or a member gets a new phone

steps.action: Open 'Your questions' on the other phone
user_sees: Only questions sent from that phone
must_not: Questions and replies from another phone or another member
The reply shown to anyone without this phone's question secret
